entries.rationale: A machzor: the work as a whole transmits a performable order of prayer, with halakhic material arranged around it. 84% of its matches arose in its service divisions and it shadowed more rows than it earned, including rows of the dedicated Amidah reference.
A siddur of the school of Rashi; same function as the machzor above. Its matches concentrated 14.7% in a single siman and the liturgy masks removed none of them.

A liturgical-halakhic compendium arranged around the order of the year; 31% of its matches arose in one 55,155-letter division interleaving the Haggadah with its own discussion, which cannot be separated at division granularity. Dropped in full by ruling rather than split.

divisions.label_he: משנה תורה, ספר אהבה, משנה תורה, סדר התפילה

entries.rationale: A volume of the Mishneh Torah, kept as a reference: its six halakhic divisions are ordinary identifying material (~517 matches). Only the appended סדר התפילה is a performable order of prayer, and it drew 1,767 of the volume's 2,284 matches -- 77.4% -- while the liturgy masks reached 2 of them, because it is Maimonides' own recension of the prayers rather than a quotation of an attested authority. הלכות תפילה וברכת כהנים stays ELIGIBLE: laws about prayer are not an order of prayer.

rule: A structurally delimited division whose primary function is to transmit a performable order of prayer or liturgical sequence is ineligible to originate ordinary source identifications. The rule applies corpus-wide, regardless of work, rite, author, or observed match yield. Mixed expository/liturgical divisions are not excluded wholesale. A reference whose work AS A WHOLE serves that function is ineligible in full.
